title: Subject Pronouns & the verb 'ser'
description: Test your knowledge of Brazilian subject pronouns and the present tense of 'ser' (to be).

questions.prompt: Which pronoun do Brazilians normally use for informal 'you'?
questions.explanation: Most of Brazil uses 'você' for both formal and informal 'you'.
'Você' takes the third-person form 'é', just like 'ele/ela é'.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct in Brazilian Portuguese?
questions.explanation: 'A gente' means 'we' but takes a singular verb: 'vai'.

questions.prompt: Listen and choose what you hear.
questions.audioText: Ela mora no Rio de Janeiro.
options: Ela mora no Rio de Janeiro.
Ele mora no Rio de Janeiro.
Eu moro no Rio de Janeiro.
questions.answer: Ela mora no Rio de Janeiro.
